purpose: Incremental official-source evidence for the existing full affiliate audit. This file is evidence only, not a new queue task or UUID. It adds five currently registered COSHUMA tools and preserves zero-cost/no-duplicate application rules.

entries.commission: 30% lifetime recurring commission while the referred subscription renews
entries.payout_terms: Commissions become payable after a 60-day refund window; payable commissions are settled during the first five days of the applicable month according to the official FAQ.
entries.eligibility: Content creators with their own channels such as YouTube, Twitter/X or LinkedIn who are willing to publish at least one AITable-related piece of content; affiliate signup does not require an additional agreement.
entries.evidence_summary: AITable's current official affiliate page confirms a live affiliate program, 30% lifetime recurring commission, 90-day cookie, affiliate portal, and direct affiliate signup.

entries.commission: 30% recurring commission on each referred business's platform subscription for 12 months
entries.payout_terms: Commissions unlock for payout after 30 days; eligible commissions can then be paid automatically.
entries.eligibility: Open to people who can introduce Time2book to fitness, wellness or small-business audiences; the affiliate does not need to be a Time2book customer.
entries.evidence_summary: Time2book's current official affiliate page confirms an open referral-link program with 30% recurring commission for 12 months, 30-day commission unlocking, and no customer-account requirement for affiliates.

entries.commission: Referral track: 10% of first-year enterprise contract value, capped at €500 per deal. Brand Ambassador track: 20% per qualifying paying referral, capped at €500 per Recruitment Pro customer; Custom deals use a separate flat-fee structure.
entries.payout_terms: Partner commissions are paid by invoice within 30 days after the qualifying deal/customer closes, according to the relevant official partner page.
entries.eligibility: Referral track targets trusted advisors with established enterprise staffing/recruitment relationships in European or US markets. Brand Ambassador track targets HR/recruitment creators with at least 5,000 followers or a 1,000+ member community. COSHUMA eligibility should be confirmed before application.
entries.evidence_summary: Carv has active official referral and ambassador monetization paths, but both have audience/market qualification requirements that cannot be safely assumed for COSHUMA, so this remains needs_manual_verification rather than automatic application-ready.

entries.network: JobHire.AI affiliate application (official page links to a HubSpot form)
entries.commission: 30% commission on every qualified referral; the current official page describes the model as recurring revenue
entries.eligibility: Official page targets bloggers, newsletter owners, YouTube creators, LinkedIn creators, career communities and others with job-seeker audiences.
entries.evidence_summary: JobHire.AI's current official affiliate page says signup is free and easy, provides an active registration path, and advertises 30% commission on every qualified referral. Cookie and payout terms were not visible on the retrieved official page and are left unknown.

entries.commission: 25% lifetime revenue share on Pay-As-You-Go purchases made through the affiliate referral
entries.payout_terms: Official page advertises real-time dashboard and self-managed payouts; exact payout threshold/timing was not stated on the retrieved public page.
entries.evidence_summary: LiftmyCV's current official affiliate page confirms a live Tolt-based program, 25% lifetime revenue share on Pay-As-You-Go plans, a real-time dashboard and self-managed payouts. Cookie duration and exact payout timing remain unknown from the retrieved official page.
